newsitem.title: UK: BAe to finalise Jetstream job cuts on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: BAe to finalise Jetstream job cuts on Tuesday.

text.p: British Aerospace Plc said on Monday it would issue redundancy notices to 275 workers at its Prestwick, Scotland plant on Tuesday, following its decision to end production of Jetstream turboprop aircraft.
A company spokesman said about 60 of the 275 workers have been offered jobs elsewhere in the group.
BAe announced in May that it would shut Jetstream production by the end of the year, with the loss of 380 jobs. The spokesman said over 100 people have since chosen to take voluntary redundancy.
Union representatives said on Monday that workers from across the group were planning to gather to demonstrate against the Prestwick job cuts at the company's central London offices on Wednesday.
